stem: Which sentence states the author’s main claim in the selection?

options.label: F
options.text: If you are looking to incorporate exercise into your routine, then you should consider walking. (paragraph 1)

options.label: G
options.text: You’re in luck, because what you’re wearing right now is probably perfect for walking. (paragraph 3)

options.label: H
options.text: As a result, walking helps your leg bones become stronger and resist the bone loss that typically happens as people get older. (paragraph 4)

options.label: J
options.text: As a bonus, walking with a friend provides a bonding opportunity to strengthen your relationships and enjoy the company of others. (paragraph 6)
